ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC$ is rotated $40^\circ$ clockwise around point $A$ to get $\triangle ADE$. If $AC \perp DE$, what is the measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC$ is rotated $40^\circ$ clockwise around point $A$ to get $\triangle ADE$\\
then $\angle CAE=40^\circ$, and $\angle C = \angle E$\\
Since $AC \perp DE$\\
then $\angle E=50^\circ$\\
thus $\angle C=\boxed{50^\circ}$
